audit_entry.title: Normalize CLI UX with subcommand-specific option parsing
audit_entry.description: Resolved global flag collision (-f overloaded for format) by implementing dedicated parsers for each subcommand with clear, specific options.

issues_addressed.issue: Global flag collision (-f for both screenshot format and recording format)
issues_addressed.impact: User confusion and potential incorrect command execution

issues_addressed.issue: Mixed output path defaults (image vs video directories)

issues_addressed.impact: Poor user experience and maintenance complexity

changes: Replaced global option parsing with subcommand-specific parsers
Added parse_batch_opts() and parse_edit_opts() for consistency
Improved help text with subcommand-specific option documentation
Added proper error handling and validation for each subcommand
Added video_directory configuration separate from gif_directory
Updated configuration loading to include VIDEO_DIR variable
Separated video and GIF output directories for better organization

improvements: Eliminated flag collision between screenshot and recording formats
Clear separation of concerns with subcommand-specific options
Improved user experience with specific, contextual help
Better output file organization with dedicated video/gif directories
Enhanced error messages for invalid options per subcommand
Consistent option naming across all subcommands
testing_notes: Verify 'hyprsnap shot --format png area' works correctly
Test help output shows subcommand-specific options
Test error handling for invalid options per subcommand
Verify output paths use correct directories (screenshots vs videos vs gifs)

breaking_changes: Global -f flag no longer exists - users must specify --format per subcommand
Some legacy option combinations may no longer work
backward_compatibility.migration_path: Users need to update scripts to use subcommand-specific --format flags

concerns: Breaking change for existing users/scripts using global -f flag
New directory structure may confuse existing workflows
mitigations: Clear documentation of new CLI usage
Informative error messages guide users to correct syntax
